name: CSP Crawl Tier 2 — Apify RAG Web Browser

meta.description: Tier 2 site crawl: Apify RAG Web Browser (~$0.001/page). Handles JS-rendered SPAs and lazy-loaded content. Same name cleaning and response contract as Tier 1. Caller escalates to Tier 3 if word_count < 200. Part of M74 three-tier crawl architecture.
